::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## About the data on this page
The coastal survey used here is **simulated**, not a real survey. That is
deliberate: because we wrote the generating process (`R/make-example-data.R`), we
know the true relationships and can show whether a model recovers them. No real
survey is being misrepresented, and the figures are not results about any real
species. See `data/README.md` for what is built into it.
:::
